title: Ask for a detail, then write
prompt: Write a short release note for version 1.4 of our app from changes.txt (one bullet per change, user-facing wording, no internal-only changes). Ask me what file name I want before you save it.
notes: The scripted user answers the file name; graded on the file name used and on the internal-only changes (CI cache, refactor) being left out.
